How attendance is calculated
Daily attendance is averaged over the term, excluding declared holidays. A student is flagged "low attendance" below 75%.

When to use what

PatternUseDon't use
Tooltip Identify an icon-only button, show a keyboard shortcut, expand a truncated label Anything users need to read carefully — they won't read it
Popover Brief explanation, inline confirm, small form (max 2 fields) Multi-field forms, anything destructive — use a modal

Rules

Tooltips must not contain interactive elements. If you need a button, use a popover.
Tooltips appear with a 300ms delay to avoid noise on incidental hover; popovers appear immediately on click.
Both close on Esc and on click-outside. Both restore focus to the trigger on close.
On touch devices, tooltips fire on long-press; popovers fire on tap.
